raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "have"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "a very busy week"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "own"
  role subject "Wojciech"
  role object "the holiday cottage in Bran"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "work at"
  role subject "Iulia"
  role object "Munteanu & Asociații"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "have for sale"
  role subject "Atelierul Neagu"
  role object "olive oil"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s5 stated
  relation "be in"
  role subject "Primăria Bistrița"
  role location "Novi Sad"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s6 stated
  relation "be in"
  role subject "Clinica Riverside din Brașov"
  role location "Reșița"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s7 stated
  relation "be the child of"
  role subject "Ethan"
  role object "Gheorghe"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s8 stated
  relation "intend to attend the parents' evening"
  role subject "Alexandru"
  polarity negated
  certainty asserted

@s9 stated
  relation "study at"
  role subject "Diego"
  role object "Academia de Muzică din Sighișoara"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted
  speaker "Zoltán"

@q query
  where match
    relation "be enrolled at"
    role subject "Diego"
    role object "Academia de Muzică din Sighișoara"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  where match
    relation "be in"
    role subject "Arena Constanța"
    role location "Orhei"
    polarity negated
  end

@q3 query
  where match
    relation "fly to"
    role subject "Achieng"
    role destination "Valencia"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q4 query
  select ?t
  where match
    relation "report to"
    role subject "Agnieszka"
    role object "Ildikó Tóth"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
